input_contract.description: Outward to Stripe. Entry: the $29 Payment Link (buy.stripe.com/...) carrying a per-launch nonce (client_reference_id) and allowing promotion codes (MSCERT2026 = 100% off for cert review). Verification: a checkout session id.

output_contract.description: Whether a checkout is FULFILLED (a 100%-off comp settles as fulfilled even with no charge), and - only then - a minted paid-session token.
output_contract.token: string | null (minted only on a fulfilled checkout)

observation_contract.description: Payment is the entry gate, nothing more: this Portal only VERIFIES fulfillment with Stripe and mints the session token; it authors no plan and runs no repair. A paid-session token exists ONLY after verifyStripeSession confirmed a fulfilled checkout - the coupling that makes the pay gate real (C1/I5).

evidence_contract.description: Stripe is the external source of truth; the fulfilled checkout is the evidence a run was paid (or 100%-off comped). No card data ever touches the app or the Pod - only Stripe holds it.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: An unfulfilled/unknown checkout -> no token minted, no session, no service. Card data is never entered into the app (Stripe-hosted checkout only).
